props.title: The Westin Westminster
props.lede: The Westin Westminster has over 100,000 sq ft of event space off US 36, between Denver and Boulder, with three ballrooms and a string of courtyards, gardens and terraces outside them.

headingText.html: It hosts big conferences, company parties and weddings, including Indian weddings, which the hotel plans for.

props.title: Event spaces at the Westin Westminster

spaces.name: Waterfall Gardens and the courtyards
spaces.facts: The Waterfall Gardens are about 19,800 sq ft outdoors, for receptions of up to 400. The North and South courtyards hold receptions of up to 350 and 400.
spaces.why: A string quartet is a classic choice for a reception out in the gardens.
spaces.alt: The Waterfall Gardens, with stepped rock and plantings below the hotel.

spaces.name: Westminster Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Westminster Ballroom is about 11,900 sq ft with 22-foot ceilings, for banquets of up to 840 and receptions of up to 1,200. It divides into four sections.
spaces.why: Little Moses Jones for a big party in the Westminster Ballroom.
spaces.alt: The Westminster Ballroom set with round tables before a wall of windows at dusk.

spaces.name: Legacy and Standley ballrooms
spaces.facts: The Legacy Ballroom is about 9,600 sq ft, for banquets of up to 675 and receptions of up to 960. The Standley Ballroom is about 4,600 sq ft, for banquets of up to 320 and receptions of up to 500.
spaces.why: Quadrasonic for a company party in the Legacy or Standley Ballroom.
spaces.alt: The empty Legacy Ballroom with windows along two walls.

spaces.name: The Lake House
spaces.facts: The Lake House is about 3,300 sq ft, for banquets of up to 200 and receptions of up to 250.
spaces.why: Tejas as a duo or a band for a wedding at the Lake House.
spaces.alt: The Lake House set with round tables beside a stone fireplace and tall windows.

spaces.name: Sunset Rooftop Deck
spaces.facts: The Sunset Rooftop Deck is about 2,700 sq ft, for banquets of up to 110 and receptions of up to 140.
spaces.why: Spanish guitar on the Sunset Rooftop Deck, for cocktails up top.

props.title: Planning music at the Westin Westminster

rows.text: The Westin has its own AV team in the building, too.
We plan the load-in and setup with the Westin’s events team ahead of your date.
The gardens, courtyards and rooftop are outdoors, so we’ll plan the music with an indoor backup in mind.

props.html: Questions about music at the Westin Westminster

items.q: How much does live music add to a wedding at the Westin Westminster?
items.a: That depends on the act and on how long you’d like music. Check out our pricing page for a general view of live music costs in Denver, and we can quote your date whenever you’re ready.
